Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public. 




Mazdoor Kisan Shakti Sangathan 
"The Right to Information, The Right to Live''

Indian Standard

SPECIFICATION FOR 
NAIU SUPRACONDYLAR, JEWETTS PATTERN 



1. Scope — Dimensions and other requirements for Jewett's pattern supracondylar nail, used as 
implant for fixing and joining of fractured bones in orthopaedic surgery, 

2. Shape and Dinnensions — As shown in Fig. 1.

FIG. 1 NAIL, SUPRACONDYLAR JEWETT'S PATTERN 

2.1 Deviation of ± 2*5 percent shall be pernnitted on all dimensions where not otherwise specified. 

3. Material — Any of the materials specified in 3 of IS ; 5347-1979 'General requirements of metal 
surgical implants ( first revision )'. 

4. Workmanship and Finish — The nail and plate portion shall be forged in one piece. 

4.1 The nail portion shall be neat and clean. 

4.2 The edges of the trifin at the tip of the nail shall be sharp. 

4.3 The plate portion shall be symmetrical and the slots ?hal! be made uniform with respect to the 
central line. 

4.4 Nails shall be free from cracks, draw marks, burrs, surface contamination and impregnated foreign 
particles, when examined under a magnification of 10 X. 

4.5 It shall be electroplated and passivated.

5. Tests 

5.1 Corrosion Resistance Test — As per 6,1 of IS : 5347-1979. 
5»2 Radiological Test — As per 6.2 of IS : 5347-1979. 

6. Marking — As per 5.1 of IS : 5347-1979. 

6.1 ISI Certification Marking — Details available with the Indian Standards Institution. 

7. Packing — The tip of each nail shall be covered with plastic coating. The nails shall then be 
packed individually in polyethylene bags. The number of such pieces packed in carton may be as 
agreed to between the purchaser and the supplier.
